topic: Features of Falcon on a Bird-Rest
questionText:
Match the pictorial element in List I with its description in List II:

List I:
(A) The Falcon's Eye
(B) The Plumage
(C) The Bird-Rest (Perch)
(D) The Tethering Cords

List II:
(I) Delicately rendered overlapping white and brown-speckled feathers showing tactile softness
(II) Intense, alert, round orb ringed with brilliant yellow-gold and a sharp black pupil
(III) Thin red cords with golden tassels securing the royal hunting bird to its perch
(IV) Cushioned horizontal wooden crossbar supported on a vertical stand decorated with cloth

Choose the correct answer from the options given below:

options.text: A-I, B-II, C-IV, D-III

options.mistakeAnalysis: Correct answer. Correctly maps each entity across columns.

options.text: A-II, B-IV, C-III, D-I
options.mistakeAnalysis: Incorrect option. Confuses related NCERT concepts or attributes.

detailedSolution:
Detailed Solution:
The eye is an alert golden ring; plumage has tactile speckled feathers; the perch is a cushioned crossbar; tethering cords are red with gold tassels.
Hence Option A is correct.
Hence, option (C) is the correct match.
